description: Copy an email component into a new component with the same description, type and blocks. Without `name`, the copy is called "<name> (Copy)", or "(Copy 2)" and so on when that name is taken. The copy is never pinned as a default, so duplicating the default footer gives a regular component to edit.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

componentId.description: ID of the email component to copy

name.description: Name for the copy, unique within the company. Omit to use the default copy name.

name: duplicate_email_component

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `duplicate_email_component` MCP tool.

component.description: The email component copy record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
